stops.stop: Moscow, the eighth of February
stops.date_confidence: attested by English Wikipedia's 'Victor Alter' for the date and for the notification of Victor Erlich. The widely repeated attribution to 'Russian president Boris Yeltsin' is anachronistic twice over and is corrected here: the USSR did not dissolve until December 1991, and Yeltsin was Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of the RSFSR from 29 May 1990 and became President of Russia only on 10 July 1991. Canonical Moscow pin.
